events.title: Poštivanje drugog kao brata u Kristu
events.title_en: Respecting the Other as a Brother in Christ
events.place: Grkokatolička župa sv. Ćirila i Metoda, Ćirilometodska 1, Zagreb
events.description: Tematska večer o tome kako se odnositi prema drugima u duhu Evanđelja. Sudjelovali su o. Serafim Smensgård (prodekan, Sankt Ignatios College, Švedska), o. Milutin Janjić (Sankt Ignatios College), pastor Kristijan Mojzeš, pastor Vladimir Janušić, prof. Aleksandar Miljković, prof. Ivica Svetec (dekan SIKD-a) i vladika mons. Milan Stipić.
events.description_en: A themed evening on relating to others in the spirit of the Gospel. Participants included Fr Serafim Smensgård (Vice-Dean, Sankt Ignatios College, Sweden), Fr Milutin Janjić (Sankt Ignatios College), Pastor Kristijan Mojzeš, Pastor Vladimir Janušić, Prof. Aleksandar Miljković, Prof. Ivica Svetec (Dean of SIKD) and Bishop Milan Stipić.

events.title: 3. tematska večer: parnice ništavnosti ženidbe
events.place: Grkokatolička župa sv. Ćirila i Metoda, Ćirilometodska 1, Zagreb
events.description: Gošća večeri bila je dr. sc. Jasmina Juroš, advokatica Rimske rote. U neformalnom razgovoru o parnicama ništavnosti ženidbe sudionici su mogli pitati o postupku, kanonskom pravu i opravdanim razlozima za pokretanje postupka. Večeri je prethodila Sveta liturgija u 18 sati.
events.description_en: The guest was Dr Jasmina Juroš, an advocate of the Roman Rota. In an informal conversation about marriage nullity proceedings, participants could ask about the procedure, canon law and valid grounds for initiating a case. The evening was preceded by the Divine Liturgy at 18:00.

projects.details:
## Sankt Ignatios College, Švedska
Studij istočne kršćanske duhovnosti i Institut surađuju sa Sankt Ignatios Collegeom iz Švedske.
- **10. 5. 2025.** zajednička međunarodna konferencija „1700 godina nakon Niceje” u Zagrebu
- **17. 5. 2026.** susret s riječkim nadbiskupom o akademskoj, kulturnoj i međukršćanskoj suradnji
- **17. – 19. 6. 2026.** posjet švedskih kolega i Dan otvorenih vrata s predstavljanjem njihova programa
projects.details_en:
## Sankt Ignatios College, Sweden
The Study of Eastern Christian Spirituality and the Institute cooperate with Sankt Ignatios College in Sweden.
- **10 May 2025** joint international conference “1700 Years after Nicaea” in Zagreb
- **17 May 2026** meeting with the Archbishop of Rijeka on academic, cultural and inter-Christian cooperation
- **17–19 June 2026** visit of the Swedish colleagues and an open day presenting their programme

courses.title: Osnove metodologije istraživanja, Uvod u znanstveni rad
courses.title_en: Foundations of Research Methodology, Introduction to Scientific Work
courses.description: Kolegij upućuje studenta u metodološka načela istraživanja i osposobljava ga za znanstveni rad kroz praktične vježbe: etape znanstvenoga rada, izrada bibliografskih i sadržajnih kartica, način navođenja literature te poznavanje i korištenje izvora za duhovnost. Kompetencija: izrada znanstvenog i diplomskog pisanog rada. Ispit je pismeni.
courses.description_en: The course introduces students to the methodological principles of research and prepares them for scientific work through practical exercises: the stages of scientific work, creating bibliographic and content cards, citing literature, and knowing and using sources for spirituality. Competence: preparing scientific and graduate written work. The exam is written.

courses.title: Istočna liturgika: Uvod u liturgiku istočnog kršćanstva
courses.title_en: Eastern Liturgy: Introduction to the Liturgy of Eastern Christianity
courses.description: Pregled, povijest i podjela istočnih kršćanskih Crkava i istočnih kršćanskih obreda (istočno-sirskog, zapadno-sirskog, koptskog, etiopskog, armenskog i bizantskog) te upoznavanje s osnovnim liturgijskim i duhovno-teološkim elementima tih obreda.
courses.description_en: Overview, history and division of the Eastern Christian Churches and rites (East Syrian, West Syrian, Coptic, Ethiopian, Armenian and Byzantine), and an introduction to the basic liturgical and spiritual-theological elements of these rites.

courses.title: Crkveno pjevanje – Istočna crkvena glazba
courses.description: Povijest glazbene umjetnosti u istočnom kršćanskom bogoštovlju te važna razlikovanja pri odabiru i stvaranju glazbe i tematike teksta s obzirom na narav i funkciju pojedinih bogoslužnih slavlja ili njihovih dijelova. Upoznaju se i smjernice koje je Crkva donijela u tom pogledu, osobito neke enciklike i konstitucija „Sacrosanctum Concilium“ Drugoga vatikanskog sabora.
courses.description_en: The history of musical art in Eastern Christian worship and important distinctions in selecting and creating music and texts in relation to the nature and function of individual liturgical celebrations or their parts. The course also introduces the Church’s guidelines in this area, especially certain encyclicals and the Second Vatican Council constitution “Sacrosanctum Concilium”.

courses.title: Povijest Crkve
courses.description: Povijest opće Crkve i istočne Crkve: opći pregled kršćanstva, a zatim povijest Crkve s naglaskom na Katoličku crkvu i njezine istočne sastavnice, točnije 18 istočnih Crkava. Posebna pozornost posvećena je razvoju Grkokatoličke crkve u Hrvatskoj od XVII. stoljeća do danas. Studenti koriste dostupnu literaturu i objavljenu građu te se upućuju na relevantne arhivske fondove.
courses.description_en: The history of the universal Church and of the Eastern Church: a general overview of Christianity, then the history of the Church with emphasis on the Catholic Church and its Eastern components, specifically the 18 Eastern Churches. Special attention is given to the development of the Greek Catholic Church in Croatia from the 17th century to the present. Students use available literature and published sources and are directed to relevant archival collections.

courses.title: Uvod u Sveto pismo
courses.description: Uvod u poznavanje Biblije: sastav i sadržaj, vremenski i povijesni smještaj nastanka pojedinih knjiga (73 knjige Svetoga pisma), osnovna znanja o nadahnuću pisaca svetih knjiga te o pristupima i metodama tumačenja svetih tekstova, tekstualni svjedoci i kritički tekstovi prema kojima se knjige prevode s hebrejskog, aramejskog i grčkog jezika, moderni prijevodi, posebno hrvatski prijevodi Svetoga pisma.
courses.description_en: An introduction to the Bible: its composition and content, the historical setting of the individual books (the 73 books of Holy Scripture), the inspiration of the sacred writers, approaches and methods of interpreting sacred texts, the textual witnesses and critical texts used to translate from Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek, and modern translations, especially Croatian translations of the Holy Scripture.

courses.title: Ikonopis
courses.description: Student upoznaje ikonopis, posebnu tehniku koju njeguje kršćanska Crkva, naročito istočne Crkve. Razlikuju se ikonopisanje (slikanje ikona na dasci) i freskopisanje (slikanje ikona – fresaka na zidu).
courses.description_en: Students are introduced to icon painting, a special technique nurtured by the Christian Church, especially the Eastern Churches. The course distinguishes between icon painting (painting icons on wooden panels) and fresco painting (painting icons – frescoes – on walls).

courses.title: Osnove grčkog jezika
courses.description: Kolegij upoznaje studente koji nisu učili grčki jezik u srednjoj školi s osnovama grčkoga jezika, preduvjetom za biblijski grčki i druge novozavjetne kolegije. Obrađuju se osnovni elementi gramatike, a praktične vježbe omogućuju usvajanje gramatike i osnovnog rječnika potrebnog za prevođenje jednostavnijih biblijskih tekstova.
courses.description_en: The course introduces students who did not study Greek at secondary school to the basics of the Greek language, a prerequisite for Biblical Greek and other New Testament courses. Basic elements of grammar are covered, and practical exercises help students acquire the grammar and basic vocabulary needed to translate simpler biblical texts.

courses.title: Ekleziologija
courses.description: Ekleziologija (grč. ἐκκλησία – sabor, Crkva; λογία – riječ, govor) teološka je disciplina koja se bavi pitanjem Crkve: njezinom ulogom, mjestom, položajem, porukom, uređenjem, djelatnošću i organizacijom.
courses.description_en: Ecclesiology (Gr. ἐκκλησία – assembly, Church; λογία – word, speech) is the theological discipline that deals with the Church: its role, place, position, message, structure, activities and organisation.

courses.title: Važnost cjeloživotnog učenja; Uvod u andragogiju
courses.title_en: The Importance of Lifelong Learning; Introduction to Andragogy

courses.title: Liturgika bizantskog obreda I.
courses.title_en: Liturgy of the Byzantine Rite I
courses.description: Upoznavanje s osnovama liturgike kao znanosti i s vlastitostima bizantskog obreda: liturgijska mjesta, liturgijske osobe (hijerarhija), liturgijski čini (Božanska liturgija, Časoslov, molitvoslovlje i blagoslovine) te liturgijski predmeti (posuđe, odjeća i knjige).
courses.description_en: An introduction to liturgy as a science and to the characteristics of the Byzantine rite: liturgical places, liturgical persons (hierarchy), liturgical services (Divine Liturgy, Horologion, prayers and blessings) and liturgical objects (vessels, vestments and books).

courses.title: Osnove kanonskog prava istočnih Crkava
courses.title_en: Fundamentals of Canon Law of the Eastern Churches
courses.description: Student sustavno upoznaje crkveno pravo slijedeći knjige Zakonika kanona istočnih Crkava, kojim su pravno uređena sva područja djelovanja i postojanja Crkve.
courses.description_en: Students systematically study church law following the books of the Code of Canons of the Eastern Churches, which regulates all areas of the Church’s life and activity.

courses.title: Crkvena administracija
courses.description: Studenti upoznaju crkvenu administraciju te vođenje pastoralnih ureda i njihove administracije.
courses.description_en: Students learn about church administration and the running of parish offices and their records.

courses.title: Osnove staroslavenskog jezika
courses.description: Porijeklo staroslavenskoga jezika i povijest slavenskih pisama, fonetski i gramatički sustav jezika, osnovne vrste tekstova te način njihova prevođenja i analize. Staroslavenski se upoznaje kao prvi književni jezik Slavena, a znanje o fonetskom i gramatičkom sustavu stječe se na tekstovima iz X. i XI. stoljeća.
courses.description_en: The origin of Old Church Slavonic and the history of Slavic scripts, the phonetic and grammatical system of the language, and the main types of texts and how to translate and analyse them. Old Church Slavonic is studied as the first literary language of the Slavs, based on texts from the 10th and 11th centuries.

courses.title: Patrologija
courses.description: Teološka disciplina koja proučava spise crkvenih otaca (grč. pater – otac). Otačko razdoblje traje od 2. do 6. stoljeća na Istoku, odnosno do 7. stoljeća na Zapadu. Student upoznaje osnovne misli velikih crkvenih mislilaca i pisaca koji su, odgovarajući na kulturalne, religijske i ideološke izazove svojega vremena, nastojali ispravno tumačiti nauk Isusa i njegovih apostola. U okviru predmeta proučava se i kršćanska arheologija.
courses.description_en: The theological discipline that studies the writings of the Church Fathers (Gr. pater – father). The patristic period runs from the 2nd to the 6th century in the East and to the 7th century in the West. Students become acquainted with the main ideas of the great Christian thinkers and writers who, responding to the cultural, religious and ideological challenges of their time, sought to interpret correctly the teaching of Jesus and his apostles. Christian archaeology is also studied within the course.

courses.title: Ekumenizam
courses.description: Ekumenizam je pokret Crkve prema zbližavanju s kršćanskim Crkvama i crkvenim zajednicama, ideja o suradnji svih kršćana na temelju ravnopravnosti i zajedničkog zalaganja za mir i opće dobro. U predmetu se upoznaju povijest, današnje stanje i načela toga pokreta prema dokumentima Crkve.
courses.description_en: Ecumenism is the Church’s movement towards closer relations with other Christian Churches and ecclesial communities, the idea of cooperation among all Christians based on equality and a shared commitment to peace and the common good. The course explores the history, present state and principles of the movement according to Church documents.

courses.title: Duhovnost istočnih kršćanskih Crkava
courses.title_en: Spirituality of the Eastern Christian Churches
courses.description: Predmet utemeljuje duhovnu teologiju istočnih kršćanskih Crkava kao znanost (formalni objekt: Bog; materijalni objekt: čovjek). Proučava duhovni život kroz njegove stupnjeve, kreposti kojima teži (ljubav, vjera, nada) te istočnu duhovnost kao praksu, s posebnim osvrtom na liturgijski molitveni život i štovanje ikona.
courses.description_en: The course establishes the spiritual theology of the Eastern Christian Churches as a science (formal object: God; material object: the human person). It studies the stages of spiritual life, the virtues it strives for (love, faith, hope) and Eastern spirituality as practice, with special attention to liturgical prayer and the veneration of icons.

courses.title: Marija u duhovnosti istočnih kršćanskih Crkava
courses.title_en: Mary in the Spirituality of the Eastern Christian Churches
courses.description: Kroz biblijske tekstove i crkvene dokumente studenti upoznaju Mariju kao Majku Crkve te njezinu ulogu u životu crkvene zajednice i mjesto u duhovnom životu svakog kršćanina.
courses.description_en: Through biblical texts and Church documents, students come to know Mary as Mother of the Church, her role in the life of the Church community and her place in the spiritual life of every Christian.

courses.title: Crkveno pjevanje – Istočna crkvena glazba
courses.description: Nastavak predmeta iz prve godine studija.
courses.description_en: Continuation of the first-year course.

courses.title: Ikonopis
courses.description: Nastavak predmeta iz prve godine studija.
courses.description_en: Continuation of the first-year course.

courses.title: Sakramenti
courses.description: Povijest utemeljenja i tumačenje sedam sakramenata (svetih tajni) Crkve: sakramenti kršćanske inicijacije (krštenje, pričest, potvrda), sakramenti ozdravljenja (ispovijed i bolesničko pomazanje) te sakramenti zajedništva (sveti red i ženidba).
courses.description_en: The history of the institution and the meaning of the seven sacraments (holy mysteries) of the Church: the sacraments of Christian initiation (baptism, Eucharist, chrismation), the sacraments of healing (confession and anointing of the sick) and the sacraments of communion (holy orders and matrimony).

courses.title: Liturgika bizantskog obreda II.
courses.title_en: Liturgy of the Byzantine Rite II
courses.description: Osnove sakramentologije bizantskog obreda: teologija i obredi svetih tajni (sakramenata), posebna bogoslužja (posvete i blagoslovine) te struktura crkvenog kalendara.
courses.description_en: The basics of the sacramental theology of the Byzantine rite: the theology and rites of the holy mysteries (sacraments), special services (consecrations and blessings) and the structure of the church calendar.

courses.title: Projekti i njihova važnost za rast Crkve
courses.title_en: Projects and Their Importance for the Growth of the Church
courses.description: Student upoznaje EU projekte i način njihove provedbe te uči prepoznati i samostalno provesti projekte i bez formalne potpore. Vlastitim projektima nastoji pomoći crkvenoj zajednici, pristupajući projektima kao važnom čimbeniku svakodnevnih aktivnosti potrebnih za rast i razvoj zajednice.
courses.description_en: Students learn about EU projects and how to implement them, and how to identify and carry out independent projects even without formal support. Through their own projects they seek to help the church community, approaching projects as an important part of the everyday activities needed for the community’s growth and development.

courses.title: Pastoralna medicina
courses.description: Student upoznaje određeni broj znanstvenih medicinskih činjenica koje mu pomažu u pristupu vjernicima i općenito ljudima čije moralno ili zdravstveno stanje zahtijeva posebnu obazrivost i pozornost.
courses.description_en: Students become acquainted with a number of scientific medical facts that help them approach believers, and people in general, whose moral or health situation calls for particular care and attention.

courses.title: Umijeće govorenja – Ars dicendi
courses.title_en: The Art of Speaking – Ars dicendi
courses.description: Govorništvo je bitan dio obrazovanja u teološkim i humanističkim znanostima. Student priprema govore i nastoji ih izložiti bez komunikacijskih pogrešaka, a veće tekstove i dijelove Svetoga pisma koji se koriste u liturgiji priprema za javno čitanje.
courses.description_en: Public speaking is an essential part of education in theology and the humanities. Students prepare speeches and learn to deliver them without communication errors, and prepare longer texts and passages of Holy Scripture used in the liturgy for public reading.
